# Raman Daksh - Freelance Software Engineer & DevOps Consultant

Freelance software engineer and IT consultant based in Dehradun, India. Specializing in Laravel, Flutter, DevOps, and full-stack architecture. 4+ years building scalable backend systems, cross-platform mobile apps, and cloud infrastructure for startups and enterprises.

## Services

- [Laravel Development](https://dakshraman.in/services/laravel-development) - Custom web apps, REST APIs, admin panels, payment integrations, queue processing
- [Flutter App Development](https://dakshraman.in/services/flutter-app-development) - Cross-platform Android & iOS apps from a single Dart codebase
- [API Design & Development](https://dakshraman.in/services/api-design-development) - Scalable, well-documented RESTful APIs with authentication and rate limiting
- [DevOps & Cloud](https://dakshraman.in/services/devops) - CI/CD pipelines, Docker containerization, cloud deployment, server management
- [System Architecture](https://dakshraman.in/services/system-architecture) - Tech stack selection, database design, cloud infrastructure, scalability planning
- [Full-Stack Development](https://dakshraman.in/services/full-stack-development) - End-to-end web apps from database to polished frontend
- [IT Consulting](https://dakshraman.in/services/it-consulting) - Code audits, architecture reviews, performance optimization, team mentoring
